prompt: In the rich, textured style of an oil painting, a wedding reception unfolds with warm, deep hues. On the left, a woman in a blue silk dress sits on a velvet chair, her posture relaxed as she holds a crystal flute. Next to her stands a man in a tuxedo with a red bowtie, who is pointing toward the center of the room where a large, multi-tiered white cake rests on a wooden table. A young boy in a striped shirt looks at the cake with wide eyes, standing beside a tall vase filled with red roses. In the center, an elderly woman in a pearl necklace leans forward, handing a small gift box to a bride in a lace gown. The bride smiles gently while accepting the present, her veil cascading down her back. To the right, a groom in a grey suit sits on a cushioned bench, his arm resting casually on the backrest. Beside him, a golden retriever lies calmly on the rug, its head resting on its paws. A waiter in a black vest stands near the edge of the frame, holding a silver tray aloft. Above them, a chandelier with crystal drops hangs from the ceiling, casting subtle reflections. There is no modern technology visible in the scene. There is no outdoor scenery or windows showing the outside world. The composition focuses entirely on the intimate indoor gathering, capturing the quiet elegance of the moment through thick brushstrokes and layered colors that emphasize the textures of fabric, fur, and glass.
